model_scope: 1X2 probability ensemble only; OU2.5 and BTTS are not part of this frozen ensemble

selection_protocol.chronology: UTC-date boundaries; first 60% base fit, next 20% hyperparameter selection, final 20% ensemble-weight selection

team_poisson.penalty: L2 on team attack and defence log effects

dixon_coles.rho_policy: rho is a fitted likelihood parameter; reference value is recorded from the 12,971-row full-training refit. On the final permitted train+validation refit it is re-estimated by the same frozen MLE algorithm using fit rows only. Never estimate or tune rho using test rows.

elo.same_day_policy: predict every fixture on a UTC calendar date before applying any results from that date

frozen_ensemble_weights.method: convex probability average; weights fixed from the separate final 20% training-only weight-calibration block

final_test.policy: Do not download, extract, read, score, or use for selection until the one-time final evaluation is explicitly run after this freeze commit is reviewed.

one_time_execution_guards: sealed artifact SHA-256 verified before extraction
test row count and date range asserted
report file opened exclusively; rerun/overwrite refused
no test-driven tuning or model selection

legacy_manifest.note: Previous root freeze_manifest.json described the separate 8,177/1,545/1,550 ZK2 logistic-regression/LightGBM experiment; it is preserved unchanged under the legacy filename.
